description: Rothco’s Police Equipment Bag is designed for police, security, and law enforcement personnel to efficiently carry their essential gear. Measuring 19 inch x 12 inch x 12.5 inch, this spacious first responder bag offers a well-organized interior with 2 zippered pockets under the lid for quick access to critical items. The U-shaped opening provides full access to the main compartment, which includes removable dividers to customize storage. Additional exterior compartments, pen pockets, and hook & loop loops ensure everything is within easy reach. Made from durable, water-resistant material, the bag is built to withstand tough conditions. A hard-shell bottom and reinforced front and back panels offer added protection for your gear. Dual handles and a detachable shoulder strap provide versatile carrying options.
